exact_rules: exactly one production Python source and one original author-test Python file
exclude any repo or PR already exposed in prior UDM training, future, method development, or historical trials
no source/test body nor patch content in metadata stage
eligibility.selection: first eligible PR per repository in frozen order; first five are TRAINING_ADMISSION, next two SEALED_FUTURE, no outcome-based replacement

native.dependency_authority: original repository source declared tests or test groups, freeze exact resolution before native
native.original: BASE production + HEAD author changed tests only
native.selector: AST changed original author test nodes only
native.require: at least one executed protected FAIL, zero errors and protected skips
native.first_failure: stop at first genuine original author protected FAIL among training order

comparators.D: competent coding agent (if unavailable explicitly NOT_RUN)
comparators.budgets: precommit equal total wall/calls/all verifier and setup costs before native outcomes

acceptance.training: two independent protected author native PASS, full relevant author file pass, physical withdrawal FAIL, restoration PASS
acceptance.G2: new source-distinct protected O2 native success with unchanged-method failure and causal withdrawal/restoration
acceptance.G4: B wins over C and D at matched total cost
